name: cultural-diffusion-mod-dev
description: Dev-only tooling for the Cultural Diffusion Civ VII mod (lint + syntax + ESM integrity + unit tests + coverage + mutation). Not shipped.

scripts.check:syntax: for f in ui/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:pressure && npm run test:pressure-branches && npm run test:state && npm run test:state-branches && npm run test:config && npm run test:cpi && npm run test:cpi-branches && npm run test:field && npm run test:field-branches && npm run test:civtuning && npm run test:civtuning-branches && npm run test:calibration && npm run test:calibration-branches && npm run test:settings
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:esm && npm test
